note: Alberta Parks campground in Gooseberry PRA, 10 km W of Bragg Creek on Hwy 66, in aspen/pine forest near the Elbow River; walk-in tent sites too, a playground, and firewood from the McLean Creek store, the manager's site or the firewood truck. --Claude
